decision_protocol: Require exact source SHA, recorded input hashes, all source rows and four saved plans to reproduce before measurement.
Measure periodicity without using label pitch, then report nominal-label and expected-cents differences separately.
Report all source/role denominators, unique crops and mixture/template exposure counts; preserve unresolved and silent classes.
Inspect concentration by source and role before proposing another model. A periodic-other crop is a disagreement to verify, not an automatic label correction.
Do not rerun or tune either rejected model from these observations. Any new representation or source-treatment experiment must have a separately frozen question and unchanged acceptance gates.
limits: Fixed-window periodicity agreement is not proof of audibility, annotation correctness, or played string.
YIN-style difference and first-threshold trough estimator; no temporal correction or claim of a validated full YIN implementation.
Octave errors, inharmonicity, low signal, beating and transients can make the independent estimate uncertain or incorrect.
All 555 intended-label sources and exact component/template crops retained. No relabeling, exclusions, fitting, threshold sweep or score changes.
Normalization gain reports the original mixture operation; it does not establish that a weak crop is invalid.
Role comparisons share one instrument/session. This diagnoses the existing experiments, not independent-player generalization.
No mixed-waveform detector replay, native timing, MIDI host delivery or live-guitar conclusion.
